description: Enhanced boundary coverage for TEXT reads (native-disjoint). The first case populates the value, insertion point, height, relative X scale (41), rotation (50), oblique angle (51) and second alignment point (11/21/31) while leaving the justification codes at their Left/Baseline defaults. The second case exercises caret control-character decoding for letter escapes (^A, ^M, ^Z map to 0x01, 0x0D, 0x1A) which the typed read reports with explicit \xHH escapes.
